beforeImage.name: Metrus Energy
beforeImage.subsector: Energy-as-a-service financing for efficiency and distributed energy
beforeImage.description: Metrus Energy finances, owns, and manages energy efficiency, renewable energy, and resiliency upgrades for commercial, industrial, higher education, and other institutional customers. Its customers use the company's energy-as-a-service structure to procure building and onsite energy infrastructure without upfront capital spending, while projects are installed and maintained through partner contractors. The business follows an asset-heavy, contracted model in which project cash flows are tied to long-term service agreements rather than merchant energy sales. Public disclosures state that Metrus has operational projects in 32 states across more than 760 sites, giving it a broad national footprint in distributed decarbonization infrastructure. ECP acquired the company in July 2022, and Metrus has since continued to scale its platform around energy efficiency, distributed generation, cooling, heating, and related low-carbon infrastructure.

afterImage.name: Metrus Energy
afterImage.subsector: Energy-as-a-service financing for efficiency and distributed energy
afterImage.description: Metrus Energy, Inc. is a U.S. Energy-as-a-Service platform that finances, owns, operates and maintains energy-efficiency, HVAC, lighting, water, solar and storage upgrades under long-term Sustainable Energy Services Agreements. Customers include commercial and industrial businesses, higher-education institutions, healthcare systems, municipalities and nonprofits. ECP acquired the company in July 2022 and continues to classify it as current; public sources do not disclose the acquisition fund, vehicle, seller, stake, co-investors or exact legal closing day, and ECP Fund V is not directly supported for this investment. Metrus reported more than 940 sites across 34 U.S. states for 2025. Metrus-named project LLCs, financed equipment, installers, lenders, tax-equity providers and customers remain subordinate structures or counterparties rather than separate PortCos or platform owners. No corporate sale, sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
